subject: Supplier onboarding: invoice window alignment + prorated first invoice
messages:
From: Sara Bell <sara@heliologistics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding / billing cadence question

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to get Helio live. I attached our completed PO_Onboarding_Form.pdf and included the SOW for reference. A couple of quick questions so our AP team can map the first invoices: 

- Our legal team usually signs SOW mid-cycle; our services start 2027-04-15. Do you prorate the first invoice to cover the 16 days, or do you bill from the next full cycle?
- Standard payment term on our side is Net 30, but we can be flexible. Can Redwood accommodate Net 30, or do you require Net 45 / Net 60 for new vendors?
- We occasionally request early-pay enrollment for transition invoices (one-off) — can we opt-in for that and what are the fees/discounts?

I attached the onboarding form. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sara Bell
Procurement Manager, Helio Logistics
---
Attachment: PO_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 243 KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bell <sara@heliologistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / billing cadence question

Hi Sara — thanks for the form and context. Looping in Rishi from Finance to confirm payment program details. Answers below and a few options so we can pick what works best for Helio: 

1) Prorated first invoice: we can either (A) prorate a first partial invoice covering 2027-04-15 through 2027-04-30, paid on the standard term; or (B) defer first billing to the start of the next full cycle (2027-05-01) and include the partial period as a separate line item on the May invoice. Our default is option B (align to cycle) to simplify remittance, but we can do a prorated APR invoice if you prefer. 

2) Payment terms: our platform supports Net 30, Net 45, and Net 60. For new vendor activation we typically set Net 45 by default for larger suppliers, but Net 30 is fine if both teams agree to the PO and SOW match our billing metadata (PO number on invoice, GL fields filled). Please confirm which term you want on the vendor record.

3) Early-pay: Finance runs an opt-in program for early-pay on select invoices (short-term advance in exchange for a small discount). Rishi — can you confirm current rates and whether onboarding invoices are eligible? I attached an Invoice_Sample.xlsx to show the metadata fields we need for the PO.

If you prefer, we can lock Net 45 now and switch to Net 30 after the first 2 invoices once remittance is validated. What's your preference?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Invoice_Sample.xlsx (XLSX, 58 KB)

> Hi Kimberly / Marissa,
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to get Helio live...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Bell <sara@heliologistics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / billing cadence question

Kimberly / Marissa / Sara — thanks for the details. Quick finance note on early-pay and discounting so everyone has the numbers: 

- Standard vendor terms supported: Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60.
- Early-pay program: vendors can opt into 10-day early settlement at a negotiated fee. For onboarding/transition invoices we typically allow early-pay but require the invoice to meet our PO and remittance validation checklist.
- Current baseline fee is 1.5% of invoice for 10-day early settlement (pilot rate). We can consider a reduced rate (1.0%) for strategic partners if the PO volume justifies it.

Regarding the first invoice: we prefer to align billing to the month boundary (option B from Kimberly) to keep our AP cutover clean, but we will honor a prorated invoice if Helio requests. If Helio wants Net 30 permanently, that is acceptable but will require a PO that includes the agreed GL and cost center mapping.

Sara — if you want Net 30 and want to enroll the onboarding invoice in early-pay, please confirm: (a) accept 1.5% fee for 10-day payment on the onboarding invoice only, and (b) confirm whether you want the first invoice prorated or included in the May cycle.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@heliologistics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Bell <sara@heliologistics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / billing cadence question

Hi Kimberly / Rishi — Tom here, CFO at Helio. Quick decision from our side after internal review: 

- We can accept Net 45 as Redwood default, but Helio prefers Net 30 operationally. To make that acceptable we propose a small trade: Helio will accept Net 45 for the ongoing program if Redwood offers a 1% early-pay discount for any onboarding invoices we opt into. Alternatively, if Redwood can switch our vendor record to Net 30 immediately and keep standard remittance requirements, we will not request any discount.

- For the first invoice (start date 2027-04-15), please prorate the April portion and include it as a separate line item on the May 1 invoice — that aligns best with our month-end close.

We are flexible; let us know which path Redwood prefers and we'll sign the SOW.

Best regards,
Tom Nguyen
CFO, Helio Logistics
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@heliologistics.com>, Sara Bell <sara@heliologistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / billing cadence question — agreed approach

Thanks Tom — appreciate the clear trade-off. To summarize the agreed onboarding plan so procurement and AP teams can proceed: 

1) Vendor terms: Helio will be set up on Net 45 as Redwood's default vendor term for the initial onboarding period.

2) Early-pay enrollment (onboarding invoice only): Redwood agrees to a 1.0% early-pay fee for a 10-day settlement on the onboarding/transition invoice (pilot reduced rate). If Helio elects early-pay for additional invoices we will review volume and rate.

3) First invoice timing: per Tom's preference, Redwood will NOT issue a prorated standalone April invoice. Instead we will include the partial-period line item on the 2027-05-01 invoice (invoice will show 2027-04-15 to 2027-04-30 prorated line). This invoice will follow the Net 45 term or early-pay option if requested.

4) PO / metadata: Helio — please return the signed SOW_Helio_signed.pdf and confirm the PO number you want on invoices. We need PO, cost center, and remittance email populated exactly as in Invoice_Sample.xlsx to avoid holdbacks.

Next steps / action items: 
- Helio: sign and return SOW (attachment) and confirm PO number (by 2027-04-08).
- Marissa: create vendor record with Net 45, add note for potential Net 30 migration after 2 successful remittances.
- Rishi: tag the onboarding invoice as eligible for 1.0% early-pay pilot if Helio requests.

I'll send a final DocuSign link for signatures and update our vendor intake checklist. Thanks all.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
